basic_details.job_title: MPMMCC Genetic Counsellor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi, has invited online applications for one contract post of Genetic Counsellor (Cancer Genetics) under Project A/c No. 160109, with monthly remuneration of ₹35,000 to ₹41,000 depending on experience. The tenure is six months and may be extended. A postgraduate degree in Genetic Counselling, Human or Medical Genetics, Life Sciences, Psychology, Nursing or MSW is required. Apply through the online form by 27 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM IST.

how_to_apply: Candidates must send in their candidature through the online application only, using the Google Forms link printed in the notice. The last date is 27.11.2026 up to 05.00 PM (Indian Standard Time). Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator.
The applicant must hold a valid email ID, because all correspondence is done by email only. Tata Memorial Centre does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of an application sent online.
Original documents supporting date of birth, qualifications, experience and similar details, to be carried to the interview by those called.
NOC from the current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator, for internal candidates.
important_instructions: If a candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. Receiving, downloading and printing of related documents is the candidate's responsibility. Tata Memorial Centre is not responsible for loss of an email caused by an invalid or wrong email ID, or by delivery to a spam or bulk mail folder. For enquiries, call 0542-6917700, Ext No. 1106/1129, or write to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre at Sunder Bagiya, BHU Campus, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh - 221005 (phone 0542-6917700). The notice also refers to Tata Memorial Centre. The post is project based and sits under Project A/c No. 160109.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a postgraduate degree in Genetic Counselling, Human or Medical Genetics, Life Sciences, Psychology, Nursing or MSW. The age limit is 45 years as on the last date of application. The notice prints no minimum age. The notice links the pay to experience: a fresher, a candidate with 01-year relevant experience and a candidate with 02-year relevant experience are paid at different rates. It does not state a minimum experience for applying. Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator. For the exact eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is on contract. The tenure will be valid for six months and may be extended further based on satisfactory performance and the institute's requirement. The notice mentions no other allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPMMCC Genetic Counsellor (Cancer Genetics)
content_sections.text: Candidates must send in their candidature through the online application only, using the Google Forms link printed in the notice. The last date is 27.11.2026 up to 05.00 PM (Indian Standard Time). Internal candidates need to submit an NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator. The applicant must hold a valid email ID, because all correspondence is done by email only. Tata Memorial Centre does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of an application sent online. Original documents supporting date of birth, qualifications, experience and similar details, to be carried to the interview by those called. NOC from the current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator, for internal candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be initially screened and called for interview on the basis of the information they provide in the online application form. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Tata Memorial Centre also reserves the right not to call any candidate for interview without assigning a reason. Candidates called for interview must carry original documents in support of the details in the online form. Those who fail to do so will not be allowed to appear for the interview. Information on the interview date will be sent by email to eligible candidates only.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If a candidate is found at any stage not to meet the eligibility criteria, or to have given incorrect, false or incomplete information or suppressed a material fact, the candidature will be cancelled. If a shortcoming is detected even after appointment, the services of the candidate are liable to be terminated forthwith. Outstation candidates should note that accommodation will not be provided. Receiving, downloading and printing of related documents is the candidate's responsibility. Tata Memorial Centre is not responsible for loss of an email caused by an invalid or wrong email ID, or by delivery to a spam or bulk mail folder. For enquiries, call 0542-6917700, Ext No. 1106/1129, or write to [email protected] .
